ema_strategy._lengths_note: Lengths are always 8/13/21/55 in BARS at the active chart interval (SIGNAL_INTERVAL): 55 bars = 55 half-hours on a 30m chart, 55 days on a 1d chart. Lengths never change; only the bar interval does. Smoothing: the three slow lines (13/21/55) are TEMA (triple EMA) and the 8 is a plain EMA — matching the TradingView chart the strategy is read from ('TEMA 13 21 55' + 'EMA 8'). A plain-EMA 55 line lags far behind the chart and reads BUY long after the chart reads SELL.
ema_strategy.buy_signal: red TEMA(55) crosses below ALL of EMA(8)/TEMA(13)/TEMA(21) — becomes lowest line
ema_strategy.sell_signal: red TEMA(55) crosses above ALL of EMA(8)/TEMA(13)/TEMA(21) — becomes highest line. For a HELD position, SELL state itself (red on top) triggers the sell even if the cross happened on an earlier bar (no fresh EXIT transition required).
ema_strategy.hold_rule: when red TEMA(55) is above all 3 — do nothing, stock is downtrending
ema_strategy.wait_rule: when red TEMA(55) is below all 3 — hold position
